thread:
maria: quick async — did a kernel perf sweep on the canary fleet earlier (microbatch=8, prefetch=on). baseline throughput looks fine but saw 95p latency spikes (~220ms) coinciding with KV eviction events. attaching a short log excerpt below. no visible user impact yet, but worth tuning before broader rollout.

aj: can you paste the exact bench command you used?

maria: command i ran:
```
./bench/run.sh --model=redwood-1.1 --seq=1024 --batch=8 --warm=300 --iters=1000 --kv-enabled
```
output snippet: ```95p=220ms median=28ms cpu=72% kv_evictions=3/min```

tom: hmm, that smells like eviction-induced tail spikes. what's kv_eviction_ratio set to on the canary?

maria: currently 0.5 (default). planning a follow-up with kv_eviction_ratio=0.75 and microbatch=4 to see delta. will also capture slot-steal metrics.

aj: also watch for slot stealing and background GC pauses — last time a similar 95p bump tracked to cross-tenant slot handoffs. add those counters to the bench run.

maria: good call — adding `slot_steal.counter` and `kv.hot_hits` to the telemetry. opening a config PR so we can toggle quickly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3421

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #3421 (:white_check_mark:) — unit + integration suites green.

aj: i'm still blocked on the kernel patch review (left comments around the memory fence + ordering). ping me after you have the new benches.

maria: will re-run with kv_hot_threshold=0.8 and microbatch=4, include slot metrics and the bench command in the results. ETA ~90m, i'll post results here.

tom: if you run into unexpected regressions i can pair — scheduling an optional 11:30am PT sync.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled 11:45am PT -> 20% nodes. Automated monitoring will pause rollout if 95p latency regresses >15% for 5m.

maria: ack :thumbsup: Thanks — will post a short summary + graphs when done.
